compare_ref.description: Reference the running commit is compared with, to count the commits not deployed. Default origin/HEAD, the remote's default branch.

max_deployments.description: Deployments searched before the line says the image is not a recent release. Default 20.

max_log_bytes.description: A job log is read up to this size, e.g. 20MiB. Default 20MiB.

per_page.description: Deployments read per request, newest first. Default 5, at most 100.

refresh.description: How old Huginn's copy of a remote, and a 'not a recent release' answer, may get before they are read again. At least 10s. Default 1m.

remote.description: Remote of each clone (repos_root/<repository>) that names its GitLab project. Default origin.

compare_ref.description: Reference compared with for this repository.

environment.description: GitLab environment by Huginn environment, instead of environments.yaml's.

job.description: Job by Huginn environment, instead of environments.yaml's.

max_deployments.description: Deployments searched for this repository (a monorepo needs more).

paths.description: Folders of this workload's code in the repository: only the commits touching them count as not deployed.

workloads.description: Exceptions of some workloads, by name (a monorepo).

repos.description: Exceptions for some repositories, by name.

token.description: Where the GitLab access token (scope read_api, role Reporter or above) is read.

file.description: Dotenv file holding the token, relative to the config folder, e.g. .env. Keep it out of git and readable by you only.

key.description: Key of the token in that file, e.g. GITLAB_TOKEN.

url.description: Base URL of the GitLab server, e.g. https://gitlab.example.com. Default: https:// and the host of each clone's remote.

version.description: Structure version of this file; must be 1.
